mapper.select: SELECT /* getUserStatusEventList */ EVENT.EVNT_NUMB , EVENT.EVNT_TYPE , EVENT.USER_NUMB , EVENT.SPND_NUMB , USERX.USER_STAT , EVENT.REGI_DATE FROM ( SELECT OUTBOX.EVNT_NUMB , OUTBOX.EVNT_TYPE , OUTBOX.USER_NUMB , OUTBOX.SPND_NUMB , OUTBOX.REGI_DATE FROM TB_EVTBOX OUTBOX ORDER BY OUTBOX.EVNT_NUMB ) EVENT LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM USERX ON USERX.USER_NUMB = EVENT.USER_NUMB WHERE ROWNUM <= #{maxSize}
